<thought>Based on the molecular ion m/z 179.0946, the exact mass matches the formula C10H13NO2. The DBE of 5 suggests an aromatic ring (4 DBE) plus a carbonyl (1 DBE). A structure that fits this formula and unsaturation is phenyl‑propyl carbamate: a phenyl ring attached to a three‑carbon chain ending in an O‑CO‑NH₂ group. Its SMILES is “c1ccccc1CCCOC(=O)N”, which gives C10H13NO2.</thought>
